status: S2-B-A2 corrective candidate; no production activation

transitions.click: ACTIVE→SENDING; disable both actions before send
transitions.send_failure_or_ack_timeout: DELIVERY_UNKNOWN; bounded sync, never decision replay
transitions.terminal: adopt Host terminal, preserve bounded pending ACK attribution if any
transitions.own_accepted_ack: Preserve sole submitted identity for current request/generation, including after bounded ACK wait. Local epoch is diagnostic, not Host-correlated.
transitions.sync_active: If request was submitted on current generation: quarantine and require fresh capability/socket/sync. Otherwise new explicit human click may be allowed.
transitions.host_terminal_conflict: ERROR/PROTOCOL_STATE_CONFLICT for incompatible Host terminals OR acceptedSubmittedDecision versus terminal/snapshot; preserve received Host evidence; no false conflict for unaccepted attempts
transitions.ambiguous_retry: Same request/generation cannot send again; shared socket rotation requires fresh trusted sync for all cards.

transport.old_generation_callbacks: ignored; current trusted sync recovers missed terminals

decision_identity.promotion: Matching current request/generation sole submitted decision plus ACCEPTED ACK; timeout ends waiting, not evidence retention.
decision_identity.lifetime: Accepted proof survives ACK-wait cleanup, sync and connection replacement; old connection cannot create new proof
decision_identity.retry: Fresh capability + strictly increasing socket generation + successful ACTIVE sync + new explicit click; one decision per request/generation
